n: DigitalMedia 8G+® 4K60 4:4:4 HDR Wall Plate Transmitter, Black (DM-TX-4KZ-100-C-1G-B-T)
d: DM-TX-4KZ-100-C-1G-B-T DigitalMedia 8G+® 4K60 4:4:4 HDR Wall Plate Transmitter, Black

specs.label: Input Signal Types
specs.value: HDMI with HDR10, Deep Color, 3D, and 4K60 4:4:4 support (DVI and Dual-Mode DisplayPort™ interface compatible)

specs.label: Output Signal Types
specs.value: DM 8G+ and HDBaseT with HDR10, Deep Color, 3D, and 4K60 4:4:4 support

specs.label: Audio formats
specs.value: Dolby Digital®, Dolby Digital EX, Dolby Digital Plus, Dolby® TrueHD, Dolby Atmos®, DTS®, DTS ES, DTS 96/24, DTS-HD® High Res, DTS HD Master Audio™, DTS:X, LPCM up to 8 channels

specs.label: IR/Serial
specs.value: 1-way device control via infrared up to 1.1 MHz or serial TTL/RS-232 (0-5 V) up to 19.2k baud via control system

specs.label: Power over DM (PoDM)
specs.value: IEEE 802.3at Type 1 Class 3 (12.95 W) compliant PoDM PD, capable of being powered by PoDM PSE (Power Sourcing Equipment)

specs.label: Power over HDBaseT
specs.value: IEEE 802.3at Type 1 Class 3 (12.95 W) compliant HDBaseT PoE PD (Powered Device), capable of being powered by an HDBaseT PoE PSE (Power Sourcing Equipment)
